topic: First in India: Male and Female
description: This topic is highly important for competitive exams. It contains a factual compilation of the first males and females to achieve top positions in various fields like Politics, Defense, Sports, and Awards in the history of India.

sections.title: Politics and Administration - Male
sections.description: The first men to hold important constitutional and political posts in the history of India.

key_associations.item: First President of India
key_associations.extra_info: He completed two consecutive terms in office.

key_associations.item: First Prime Minister of India
key_associations.extra_info: He had the longest tenure as Prime Minister.

key_associations.item: First Governor-General of Independent India
key_associations.extra_info: He was also the last Viceroy of India.

key_associations.item: First and Last Indian Governor-General of Independent India
key_associations.extra_info: He was the only Indian to hold this prestigious post.

key_associations.item: First Speaker of Lok Sabha
key_associations.extra_info: He is popularly known as the 'Father of Lok Sabha'.

key_associations.item: First Chief Election Commissioner of India
key_associations.extra_info: He assumed office in 1950 and successfully conducted the first two general elections.

key_associations.item: First Chief Justice of India
key_associations.extra_info: He was the first head of the Supreme Court of Independent India.

important_facts.fact: The first Education Minister of Independent India was Maulana Abul Kalam Azad.

sections.title: Politics and Administration - Female
sections.description: The first women to reach the highest positions in Indian politics and administration.

key_associations.item: First Female President of India
key_associations.extra_info: She served as the 12th President of India from 2007 to 2012.

key_associations.item: First Female Prime Minister of India
key_associations.extra_info: She is also famously known as the 'Iron Lady of India'.

key_associations.item: First Female Governor in India
key_associations.extra_info: She served as the Governor of the state of Uttar Pradesh.

key_associations.item: First Female Chief Minister in India
key_associations.extra_info: She served as the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh in 1963.

key_associations.item: First Female Judge of the Supreme Court
key_associations.extra_info: She was appointed to the Supreme Court of India in 1989.

key_associations.item: First Female IPS Officer of India
key_associations.extra_info: She was an officer of the 1972 batch of the Indian Police Service.

key_associations.item: First Female Speaker of Lok Sabha
key_associations.extra_info: She presided over the 15th Lok Sabha in 2009.

important_facts.fact: The first female President of the UN General Assembly was Vijaya Lakshmi Pandit in 1953.

sections.title: Defense and Space
sections.description: First Indians to create history in the Indian Armed Forces and Space Exploration.

key_associations.item: First Field Marshal of India
key_associations.extra_info: He was the chief strategist and hero of the Indo-Pak War of 1971.

key_associations.item: First Indian in Space
key_associations.extra_info: He traveled to space in 1984 under the Soviet Space Program.

key_associations.item: First Woman of Indian origin in Space
key_associations.extra_info: She flew on NASA's Space Shuttle Columbia mission in 1997.

key_associations.item: First Commander-in-Chief of Independent India
key_associations.extra_info: He took charge of the Indian Army from the British Commander on 15 January 1949 (celebrated as Army Day).

key_associations.item: First Indian Chief of Air Staff
key_associations.extra_info: He was appointed as the head of the Indian Air Force in 1954.

sections.title: Awards and Honors
sections.description: First Indians to receive prestigious awards at the national and international levels.

key_associations.item: First Indian to get a Nobel Prize
key_associations.extra_info: He was honored in 1913 in the field of Literature for his work 'Gitanjali'.

key_associations.item: First Indian Woman to get a Nobel Prize
key_associations.extra_info: She was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 1979 for her humanitarian work.

key_associations.item: First Persons to get Bharat Ratna
key_associations.associated_with: Dr. S. Radhakrishnan, C. Rajagopalachari, C. V. Raman
key_associations.extra_info: This is India's highest civilian award, established in 1954.

key_associations.item: First Person to get Jnanpith Award
key_associations.extra_info: He received this award in 1965 for his contribution to the Malayalam language.

key_associations.item: First Indian Citizen Woman to win the Booker Prize
key_associations.extra_info: She was honored in 1997 for her novel 'The God of Small Things'.

key_associations.item: First Indian to win an Oscar
key_associations.extra_info: She won an Oscar for Best Costume Design for the 1983 film 'Gandhi'.

important_facts.fact: The first person to receive the Bharat Ratna posthumously was Lal Bahadur Shastri.

sections.title: Sports and Adventure
sections.description: First Indians to set records in the world of sports and mountaineering.

key_associations.item: First Indian to climb Mount Everest
key_associations.extra_info: He successfully hoisted the Indian flag on the world's highest peak in 1965.

key_associations.item: First Indian Woman to climb Mount Everest
key_associations.extra_info: She achieved this historic feat in 1984.

key_associations.item: First Indian to win an individual Olympic medal
key_associations.extra_info: He won a Bronze medal in wrestling at the 1952 Helsinki Olympics.

key_associations.item: First Indian Woman to win an Olympic medal
key_associations.extra_info: She won a Bronze medal in weightlifting at the 2000 Sydney Olympics.

key_associations.item: First Indian to swim across the English Channel
key_associations.extra_info: He set this record in 1958.

key_associations.item: First Indian and Asian Woman to swim across the English Channel
key_associations.extra_info: She completed this adventurous task in 1959.

important_facts.fact: The first Indian to win an individual Gold Medal in the Olympics is Abhinav Bindra, who achieved this feat in shooting at the 2008 Beijing Olympics.
